name: ALEX EXAMPLE
summary: Test analyst with three years of experience in software quality assurance. Experienced in SQL validation, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and defect investigation. Collaborates with developers and business users to clarify requirements and support reliable releases.

experience.title: Test Analyst
bullets: Designed and executed test scripts from business requirements, documenting expected results and maintaining traceability through release cycles.
Used SQL queries to validate application data and investigate discrepancies during user acceptance testing.
Logged reproducible defects, worked with developers to clarify root causes, and retested fixes before release.
Maintained regression test packs and reduced repeated defects by 20% through targeted release checks.

experience.title: Junior Tester
bullets: Executed functional tests and documented findings for the development team.

additionalSections.heading: Certifications
items: ISTQB Foundation Certificate in Software Testing | 2021
